cards: These swine abominations have festered the warrens for far too long. Enter the warrens, find their quarters and give them none! Eradicate their lair, lest they eradicate us!

The vast sewer network has lied abandoned for far too long. Yet some sinister forces gather in its deep shadows. Enter the sewers and map them out. Make sure you learn part of their layout for future expeditions.

The villagers have lived in constant fear for far too long. Some brave souls entered the warrens to combat the evil that resides within, never to return. Their relatives beg of you to go there, find their bodies and bring back the trinkets and mementos that belonged to them. A small consolation for their loss.

Spawn only Rooms with Loot Chests in Lairs. The first chest you Loot in each Lair contains a Level 2 Trinket. Returning to the Hamlet, you may return any trinkets of level 2 acquired in the dungeon (up to a maximum of 3 trinkets).

Feral beasts known as the carrion eaters have begun to emerge on the surface from the depths of the warrens below. Their numbers must have increased from the amount of corpses littering their halls. Enter the dark murky warrens, find them, and eradicate them.
Objective Room is always Room [warrens]8. Spawn a Large Carrion Eater (LvL 2) when starting a battle there.

Not only have the beasts increased their numbers, but they are also arming themselves with stolen armaments from the guards they kill. They must be storing them, somewhere beneath our feet. Venture deep into the warrens' bowels, find their storage room and put it to the flames.
Objective Room is always Room [warrens]6. Spawn only [warrens] Monsters there.

Never ever have these filthy beasts acted as disciplined as they do now. It's apparent that one of them has won their trust. A dark leader that forms them up in regiments, and soon to be an army. Bring that beast's reign to an end, once and for all.

Objective Room is always Room [warrens]9. Spawn a Swine Skiver (LvL 3) and a Large Carrion Eater there, plus a random monster of normal or small size to fill the Stances. The Battle ends immediately once the Swine Skiver is killed.

Things have gotten out of hand, as buried corpses start to disappear. This means that the carrion beasts have grown rampant. No matter how many you put to the sword, it won't be enough. Find their breeding grounds and smash their eggs. Make sure no single maggot stays alive...

In Objective Rooms, spawn one Large Carrion Eater and two Carrion Eaters. When a Large Carrion Eater dies, replace it immediately with a Carrion Eater. When a Carrion Eater dies, replace it immediately with a Maggot. The fight ceases and the room is secured as soon as there are only Maggots left in play.

It is widely known that these gluttonous beasts crave food above all else. Take some extra bundles and head into the warrens. Lure them out from the shadows and kill them all, especially the malevolent swine skiver.

Before entering the Dungeon, gain 3 additional [food]. When in an empty Room, you may spend a [food] to bait a Swine Skiver (LvL 3). Start battle immediately in a random Room with a Swine Skiver, then roll a [d10]: 1-4 spawn 2 additional monsters of normal or small size, 5-8 spawn 3 additional monsters of normal or small size, 9-10 nothing.

We've mounted so many expeditions to the sewers, yet we haven't mapped them adequately. You still have to do this perilous task, for it is of utmost importance that we know where our enemies dwell and where they're coming from.

Lately reports have mentioned a new breed of swinefolk, more potent, hardened and resistant to diseases. If their genes are passed down through their kind, we're doomed. Search for these beasts and bring an end to their kind. It's either them or us...
Warrens Monsters are immune to Conditions.

Filth, rot and humidity are the primary enemies we have yet to overcome in the warrens. Their halls festering with disease such that even the air is toxic. Enter these halls, and find the toxic lairs from where this disease emanates. Expect time to be your primary enemy as your provisions will run bad, faster than expected.
After you leave a Room, choose and discard a Provision.

Among their kind, there is an alpha swine - a monster that the swines idolize. A Swinetaur that poses a threat far more dangerous than any that you have overcome. Go there, find it and kill it as soon as possible. Expect a strong resistance though, for the swines will fervently defend their new alpha like a rabid pack of wolves.
In Lairs, always spawn a Swinetaur. [warrens] Monsters in Lairs have +1 Crit

You have suffered many things, but the worst is yet to come. In the warrens there is a foul room filled with rancid smell and pestilence. A fitting start for a new plague... Find this room and solve this problem. Be careful, though, as the new disease is far more contagious than expected.
Objective Room is always Room [warrens]6. When a Hero is dropped to Death's Door when fighting there, they suffer [disease].

Like humans often do, the swine are fighting each other, amidst a heated leader crisis. Now is the time to brave the shadows of the warrens and move unseen. Strike fast and bring down the strongest of their kind!

Always spawn a Swine Skiver in Lairs. You cannot Scout in this Quest. Instead, before advancing to a Room, you can reveal one adjacent. If you move towards a revealed Lair, move there without exploring. For the first round in each Lair, place all Hero Initiative Cards on top of the deck.

Do you hear them? These are their drums of doom... Coming from deep in the warrens, the swine are gathering for their dark masses. Your mission is of utmost importance, for you need to go down there and eradicate as many drummers as possible. Drag their bodies, along with their morale, to the muddy, rancid ground.

Always spawn a Swine Drummer in Lairs. The first Monster you spawn after this gains [guard]4t. When it dies, the remaining [guard] goes to the next Monster in Stance priority order. When a Swine Drummer is activated in Lairs, all Monsters gain [buff]2t, [buff]2t.
